transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
Once I start talking, I just can't seem to stop. I feel like I have to get every single idea out all at once, and people keep telling me that I'm completely overwhelming them.
Have you ever experienced a period in your life where you felt consistently low, hopeless, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy for two weeks or more?

No, I haven't really ever experienced a period of feeling consistently low or hopeless like that. My mood has generally been pretty normal, or lately, it's been the exact opposite where I feel incredibly revved up and on top of the world.

During these times when you feel revved up and on top of the world, have you ever heard voices or seen things that others couldn't, or felt like you had special powers or secret knowledge that others didn't have?

Yes, lately at night I hear a clear male voice over my shoulder telling me to "push harder" or that "they're watching" if I slow down. I'm also completely convinced the CEO and board are tracking my messages because I've cracked a massive, industry-changing strategy. These things only started happening recently since I got into this super-charged, sleep-deprived state.
